name: Frederick
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Frederick, CO 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Frederick, CO for 2026: Festival of Lights parade and tree lighting, a princess tea and Dacono's festival, dates checked.
lede: Frederick lights Crist Park on the first Saturday of December with a parade and a tree lighting, and shares the Carbon Valley holiday festivities with Firestone and Dacono.
celebrates: The Town of Frederick starts the season with its Festival of Lights in Crist Park, where a parade at 5:30 pm leads into the tree lighting at 6 pm, according to the town. The town adds free horse-drawn carriage rides, a live ice sculpture demonstration, selfies with Santa and carolers. Frederick is one of three Carbon Valley towns, with Firestone and Dacono, that hold a holiday festival on the same Saturday, each hosting its own part. For a dressed-up outing, Magical Moments, a tea shop on 6th Street, hosts a holiday princess tea and concert on December 12.
lastyear: Last year the Carbon Valley Holiday Festival was held on Saturday, December 6, 2025, with Firestone's portion from noon to 4 pm, according to a listing of the town's event, and Dacono's evening portion at 4 pm in Clem DuFour Park, according to the city's post. The Town of Frederick's calendar lists its Treelighting and Festival of Lights as an annual evening from 5:30 to 8 pm in Crist Park, so this year's Festival of Lights follows the same pattern, while Dacono has moved its part to City Hall.
facts: Crist Park, at 105 Fifth Street, is also home to the Miners Memorial Museum, the town's history museum. The museum's exhibits, arranged by the Historic Preservation Committee, tell the story of the coal camp that became Frederick, with a diorama of the original townsite, mining tools, a coal stove, the original mayor's chair and old school desks. The town's events calendar also lists Frederick in Flight, Chainsaws and Chuckwagons and Miners Day among its yearly events.
trains: Neither Frederick nor Firestone has a holiday train we could verify for 2026. The nearest holiday rail outing in our guides is the Polar Express Train Ride at the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden, which runs November 6 to December 23, 2026, according to our event listing. The Colorado Model Railroad Museum in Greeley is a year-round alternative; our museum guide lists adult tickets at $15 and closed days on Tuesday and Wednesday.

faq: The Town of Frederick holds its Festival of Lights in Crist Park on Saturday, December 5, 2026, with a parade at 5:30 pm, the tree lighting at 6 pm, free horse-drawn carriage rides, an ice sculpture demonstration, selfies with Santa and carolers. A tea shop adds a holiday princess concert on December 12.
When is the Frederick Festival of Lights?

It is Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5:30 to 8 pm at Crist Park, 105 Fifth Street. The parade begins promptly at 5:30 pm and the tree lighting follows at 6 pm, according to the Town of Frederick, who lists admission as free to attend.
Is the Frederick Festival of Lights free?

Yes. The Town of Frederick lists the Festival of Lights as free to attend, and the horse-drawn carriage rides are free as well. Local businesses and organizations can apply to join the parade. The festival runs from 5:30 to 8 pm in Crist Park at 105 Fifth Street on Saturday, December 5, 2026.
Are there other holiday festivals near Frederick the same day?

Yes. The Carbon Valley Holiday Festival is shared by three towns on December 5, 2026. Firestone's part runs noon to 4 pm at Miners Park and Dacono's part runs 4 to 6 pm at Dacono City Hall. Each town runs its own event, so check each host for its times.
Where can kids meet Santa near Frederick?

Santa takes selfies at the Festival of Lights in Crist Park on December 5, appears for photos at Dacono's festival from 4 to 6 pm the same day, and rides through neighborhoods with the Frederick-Firestone Fire District on December 19 to 21.
Is there a holiday train near Frederick?

Not in town that we could verify. The closest is the Polar Express Train Ride at the Colorado Railroad Museum in Golden, which runs November 6 to December 23, 2026. The Colorado Model Railroad Museum in Greeley is another option, with adult tickets listed at $15.
